description: Aggregation projection with the exact lowercase function name.

age.statement: SELECT * FROM cypher('age_graph', $$ MATCH (p:Person) RETURN AVG(p.age) AS avg_age $$) AS (avg_age agtype)

sql_pgq.statement: SELECT AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS "Person") COLUMNS (p.age AS age))

duck_pgq.statement: SELECT AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS "Person") COLUMNS (p.age AS age))
